data.name: Lost Galaxy: Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Defend the Portal. Survive the Swarm.

Humanity’s last gateways are collapsing.

Fight against relentless alien hordes as you defend massive interdimensional portals across hostile worlds in this fast-paced sci-fi top-down survival shooter.

In Lost Galaxy: Survivors, survival alone is not enough. Every run is a desperate battle to protect the portal from overwhelming enemy swarms while building devastating loadouts, adapting your strategy, and holding the line against impossible odds.

If the portal falls, everything is lost.

HOLD THE LINE

Alien creatures don’t just hunt you — they attack the portal itself.

Fight through escalating waves of enemies, elite monsters, and massive swarms while defending the core of the battlefield. Position yourself carefully, manage enemy pressure, and survive as the chaos intensifies every minute.

Each world becomes a desperate last stand.

BUILD YOUR SURVIVOR

Level up during each run and create powerful build combinations with:

  • Weapons

  • Damage upgrades

  • Fire rate boosts

  • Drones

  • Mobility abilities

  • Survival enhancements

  • Experimental combat upgrades

Every run evolves differently depending on your choices and playstyle.

FEATURES

⚔️ Fast-Paced Sci-Fi Combat

Responsive movement, intense firefights, and nonstop enemy pressure.

🛡️ Portal Defense Survival Gameplay

Defend the portal at all costs while surviving endless alien attacks.

⚙️ Dynamic Build Variety

Experiment with powerful upgrade combinations and evolving combat styles.

👾 Escalating Alien Swarms

Fight increasingly dangerous enemies, elite units, and chaotic battlefield events.

🌍 Multiple Hostile Worlds

Battle across dangerous planets and sci-fi environments, each centered around defending a portal under siege.

🔥 Endless Replayability

Adapt, improve, and push further with every run.

EARLY ACCESS / PLAYTEST NOTICE

Lost Galaxy: Survivors is currently in active development.

Features, balancing, visuals, and gameplay systems will continue evolving throughout development based on community feedback.

Your feedback helps shape the future of the game.

WILL YOU SURVIVE?

The swarms never stop.

The pressure keeps rising.

And the portal must survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850, 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD RX 590, 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or above
  • Processor: Intel Core i5, Apple Silicon (Rosetta 2 supported)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU (Intel Iris, AMD, Apple M1/M2)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS Tahoe 26 or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3 recommended) or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated or dedicated AMD GPU
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
